races.paceDynamic: Stag Night will likely lead with Cuban Grey, Likedbymike, Buddy Batt and Ribble Emperor pressing from prominent positions early. The soft ground and 5f sprint distance means the pace won't be blistering, allowing the leaders to maintain their advantage. With multiple hold-up horses like Shadow Of The Moon, Sommelier, Gazelle d'Or, Sarahmae and Noble Nation needing to come from behind, the track may not provide enough time for late closers to make up ground. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those able to travel well in the first half of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and sustainable on soft ground
scenarios.body: The leaders get an easy time of it and kick for home with the hold-up horses unable to make up the ground in time. Stag Night, Cuban Grey, Likedbymike and Buddy Batt are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the hold-up horses get their opportunity to strike late. Shadow Of The Moon and Noble Nation can use their fresh finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy scramble with uneven pace
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in mid-division can pick their way through and time their runs perfectly. Those with tactical speed but not committed to the early battle benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the soft conditions or distance
scenarios.body: Long-absent runners or those with question marks surprise at bigger odds. The race opens up for horses whose form figures don't tell the full story.

races.paceDynamic: Astute Power is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate a measured tempo over 6f on soft ground with 21 runners providing natural cover. Art Of Unity and Royal Impact can press from prominent positions but lack the speed to create genuine pressure early doors. The large field creates inevitable traffic problems in the straight, while the soft conditions will blunt finishing kicks. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and early movers who can secure good positions without relying on a devastating turn of foot through the pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Tempo Benefits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Astute Power sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The patient pace allows prominent runners to travel sweetly before quickening, while hold-up horses struggle to make ground through traffic on testing ground. Early positioning proves crucial as the soft turf saps late momentum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Favours Rails
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a wall of horses in the straight with limited room for manoeuvre
scenarios.body: Runners drawn low or tracking the pace on the inside secure clear runs while those coming from midfield and wide get shuffled back. Patient tactics backfire as gaps fail to materialise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Levels Field
scenarios.trigger: If the testing conditions significantly reduce the effectiveness of class horses and create an open handicap
scenarios.body: Lower-rated runners with proven soft ground form can outbattle their superiors as stamina becomes more important than raw speed. The pace collapse favours those who stay on strongest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Through Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If gaps appear in the straight and the soft ground doesn't completely kill finishing speed
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up horse with the right pilot threads through to land the spoils as others tire from their earlier efforts. Class tells in the final furlong despite tactical disadvantages.

This pace setup and ground conditions clearly favour the hold-up horses - Omni Man, Beset and Starford - who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver late challenges when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the strong early pace is maintained throughout and the prominent brigade weakens significantly
scenarios.body: The genuine stamina test exposes those who have raced keenly early, allowing the patient hold-up runners to sweep past tired leaders. Beset and Omni Man are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their proven ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivors Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If one or two horses from the crowded prominent group can secure clean runs and avoid interference
scenarios.body: Red Letter or Royal Rhyme could benefit from their class advantage if they navigate the traffic successfully in the straight. Their superior ratings give them the edge over hold-up horses if they avoid pace complications.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Green Impact or Trustyourinstinct can dictate terms and avoid being overtaken by the field
scenarios.body: An uncontested leader could exploit the soft ground by setting honest fractions that others cannot match late. Green Impact's recent win and Trustyourinstinct's course experience make them capable of staying clear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front runners go too fast early and burn out before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3-furlong pole, suiting horses with turn of foot rather than pure stamina. This unlikely scenario would favor those with tactical speed who avoided the early burn-up.

races.paceDynamic: Cantilever is the sole confirmed front runner in this 24-runner maiden and will likely get an easy lead on soft ground that typically produces steady early fractions. With prominent runners like Starman Tom, Thenandnow, Cactus, and Dreaminthejungle likely to track but not pressure early, the pace will be moderate rather than strong. The large field suggests scrimmaging in midfield with hold-up horses like Classical Symphony, Glen And Tonic, and Magna Kotcha getting cover but potentially finding traffic problems in the straight. This sustainable pace scenario clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can avoid the inevitable traffic in such a big field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Cantilever gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of class from the 2f pole with prominent runners having the positional advantage to strike. Horses like Starman Tom, Thenandnow and Cactus can use their tactical pace to get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight with runners getting blocked
scenarios.body: Early leaders and those in the clear avoid the worst of the scrimmaging behind. Cantilever's front-running tactics prove decisive while a prominent runner like Dreaminthejungle finds racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finish By Hold-ups
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the 3f pole creating gaps for back markers
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses like Classical Symphony and Glen And Tonic get the strong gallop they need to unleash finishing kicks. The 6f trip becomes a proper test of stamina on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers shows significantly more ability than expected
scenarios.body: The betting market has underestimated the talent of a first-time starter who benefits from the steady pace. Trainers like J A Stack and Joseph O'Brien are capable of producing ready debutants in maidens.

races.paceDynamic: L L Koulsty will be the primary pace-setter from stall position, with Sun Soldier, Smoke Them Out, Mickey The Steel, Merisi Diamond and Red Charlie all likely to race prominently in the opening stages. This creates a moderate pace scenario rather than crawling fractions, as six horses have prominent tendencies but none are confirmed tearaway leaders. The large field of 17 runners on soft ground over 7f at the Curragh will see the pace quicken from the 3f marker as the hold-up horses make their moves. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain honest fractions through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The testing soft ground and 7f trip will find out the pace-setters in the final 2f, allowing the patient hold-up brigade to sweep past. Horses like Goal Exceeded, San Aer, Jon Riggens and Local Lad possess the tactical speed and stamina reserves to capitalize.

races.paceDynamic: Gonna Be Golden will likely take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, setting a sustainable pace that won't burn out early leaders. The prominent runners Johnny Soda, Hambelton, Down The Glen and Closely should track close behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Hamiyan, Boston Benjamin, and Venetian Star will need to rely on the pace collapsing late. With only one confirmed front runner and multiple hold-up horses needing the leaders to come back to them, this setup creates a tactical advantage for the early-positioned horses who can avoid traffic and kick clear when the soft ground starts to tell. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Gonna Be Golden maintains a steady gallop without folding dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The early-positioned horses can kick clear while the hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed on the testing ground. Prominent runners with tactical speed edge out both the spent leader and the back-markers who never get into contention.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly unsustainable and the leaders tie up badly in the soft conditions
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash telling late runs from off the speed. Quality closers with proven stamina reserves can pick off the early leaders who've done too much work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gonna Be Golden gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina reserves for a strong finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control the tempo perfectly and prove too strong for both the stalkers and closers. Prominent runners get caught in no-man's land while hold-up horses leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate early but quickens significantly from the 3f pole onward
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse with untapped ability gets the ideal racing scenario to produce a career-best effort. The uneven pace distribution catches out both leaders and prominent runners, creating gaps for a swooper.

watchPoints.text: Gonna Be Golden could steal this if allowed to coast in front unchallenged, as lone pace-setter often benefits in soft ground sprints
Johnny Soda and Down The Glen are the key prominent runners to follow - if either gets first run on the field they'll be hard to peg back
Hamiyan needs to show early pace from his hold-up style to avoid getting too far back in what could become a truly-run race
The hold-up horses collectively could struggle if Gonna Be Golden sets only a moderate pace, leaving them with too much ground to make up
Boston Benjamin's recent Sligo win came in similar conditions and his finishing kick could be potent if getting the right setup
